channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: RAF extends Gladiator training support to 2028
item.description: The £16.9m deal maintains Gladiator until 2028 and funds integration of F-35, Typhoon and air C2 into the RAF’s synthetic battlespace. The post RAF extends Gladiator training support to 2028 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: King salutes new officers at Dartmouth passing-out parade
item.description: The King has marked the commissioning of nearly 200 junior officers at Britannia Royal Naval College, Dartmouth, returning to the institution where he began his own naval career almost 55 years ago. The post King salutes new officers at Dartmouth passing-out parade first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Armed Forces personnel recognised in New Year Honours
item.description: Personnel recognised include humanitarian responders, rehabilitation leaders and specialist operators whose work underpins UK military readiness. The post UK Armed Forces personnel recognised in New Year Honours first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: France orders Saab GlobalEye for airborne early warning
item.description: France has ordered two Saab GlobalEye aircraft with options for two more and deliveries from 2029. The post France orders Saab GlobalEye for airborne early warning first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Denmark cleared for purchase of P-8 maritime patrol aircraft
item.description: The US State Department has approved a possible $1.8 billion Foreign Military Sale to Denmark for up to three Boeing P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol and reconnaissance aircraft. The post Denmark cleared for purchase of P-8 maritime patrol aircraft first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Dutch warship downs ‘drone swarm’ off British coast
item.description: The Royal Netherlands Navy has completed its first participation in Exercise Sharpshooter, a QinetiQ-run training series blending live and synthetic threats to simulate complex swarm attacks. The post Dutch warship downs ‘drone swarm’ off British coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US orders 350 Tomahawk land attack cruise missiles
item.description: The U.S. Navy has confirmed a major order with Raytheon for the production of 350 Block V Tactical Tomahawk cruise missiles, with some work being performed in the UK. The post US orders 350 Tomahawk land attack cruise missiles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Extended-range GMLRS test hits 112 km from HIMARS
item.description: Lockheed Martin has carried out a 112-kilometre flight test of its Extended-Range Guided Multiple Launch Rocket System from a HIMARS launcher at White Sands Missile Range. The post Extended-range GMLRS test hits 112 km from HIMARS first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Skunk Works links with XTEND for multi-drone control
item.description: Lockheed Martin Skunk Works and Israeli firm XTEND have integrated the XTEND Operating System into the MDCX autonomy platform to enable a single operator to control multiple classes of uncrewed aircraft at once. The post Skunk Works links with XTEND for multi-drone control first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rolls-Royce starts engines tests for U.S. FLRAA prototypes
item.description: Rolls-Royce has begun engine testing for the AE 1107F, the propulsion system selected to power prototypes of the U.S. Army’s MV-75 Future Long Range Assault Aircraft, the company stated. The post Rolls-Royce starts engines tests for U.S. FLRAA prototypes first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
